Averages are per raid the player attended; only players with at least 3 raids in the window are ranked. A player without data for a board (never healed, no boss kills as DPS) is left off it rather than ranked as zero. DPS/HPS are WarcraftLogs kill numbers averaged over the player's boss kills. Dispels are split by what was removed: Magic, Curse, Poison, Disease and Enrage (Tranquilizing Shot); a type board lists only players who removed that type. Hover a total for its split. Poison Cleansing Totem cleanses are not logged as dispels, so they count nowhere above; the totem board shows how many each shaman placed per raid instead (MH / BT nights only). Best parse average is the Parses tab's Best Ø: each boss's best parse, averaged (within MH / BT for the default view, over every boss with a best parse for all time). Consumables used counts potions, runes, drums, herbs, bandages, explosives and other bought or crafted items from RPB (conjured mana gems and healthstones excluded); hover a value for the most-used items. It exists for MH / BT nights only, so its raids column can be lower than the others.
